Wholesale Beetroot Powder for Food and Ingredient Manufacturers

Tradenest Naturals supplies wholesale beetroot powder made from carefully selected beetroot and processed for dependable performance in food, beverage, bakery, nutraceutical and seasoning applications. Our dehydrated beetroot powder is developed for buyers seeking consistent colour, convenient handling, extended shelf life and scalable bulk supply from a reliable Indian manufacturer. Available in standard and customized specifications, it is suitable for importers, distributors, FMCG brands, private-label businesses, food processors and export-oriented manufacturers. As a dehydrated beetroot powder supplier and exporter from India, Tradenest Naturals supports both standard orders and customer-specific requirements. Buyers can request beetroot powder 80 mesh, alternative particle sizes, bulk dehydrated beetroot powder, private-label packing or application-oriented formulation guidance. Contact our team with your required quantity, destination, packaging format and technical specification to request a sample, quotation and production timeline.

Product Overview

Dehydrated beetroot powder is produced by cleaning, trimming, slicing or preparing beetroot, removing moisture under controlled conditions, milling the dried material and sieving it to achieve a uniform powder. The finished ingredient provides the characteristic deep red to reddish-purple appearance and earthy, mildly sweet beetroot flavour expected from the raw material. It is convenient to dose, easy to blend and suitable for dry mixes and recipes where fresh beetroot is impractical. The product is supplied without unnecessary bulk water and is designed for efficient storage, transportation and processing. Standard production can be adjusted according to the buyer's requirements for mesh size, moisture, packaging, labelling and order volume. Product performance may vary according to the recipe, process conditions and desired colour intensity, so application trials are recommended before commercial adoption.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals follows controlled processing practices designed to protect raw-material identity, product cleanliness and batch consistency. Beetroot is inspected and prepared before dehydration. The dried material is then pulverized and passed through sieving equipment to obtain the required particle size. For standard supply, an 80 mesh profile may be offered, while other mesh ranges can be discussed for beverage, bakery, seasoning or premix applications.
  • Raw-material selection and incoming inspection
  • Cleaning and preparation of beetroot
  • Controlled dehydration for moisture reduction
  • Grinding and pulverizing to the agreed particle size
  • Sieving for improved uniformity
  • Batch packing with traceability information
Tradenest Naturals can also evaluate custom formulation, blending, private-label packing and application-specific development. Any requested specification is reviewed before production so that raw materials, processing parameters, packaging and documentation can be aligned with the buyer's needs.

Typical Technical Specifications

Typical commercial specifications for this product include 80 mesh, moisture generally up to approximately 8%, and purity generally 100% beetroot powder without added carriers, colours or preservatives. These are indicative values for commercial discussion and remain subject to the agreed product specification, batch testing, destination-country requirements and application needs. A batch-specific certificate of analysis or other quality documents can be discussed where required.
  • Product: Dehydrated beetroot powder
  • Standard mesh: 80 mesh, with alternate sizes available on request
  • Typical moisture: Up to approximately 8%
  • Ingredient purity: Typically 100% beetroot powder
  • Appearance: Fine red to reddish-purple powder
  • Flavour: Earthy, mildly sweet and characteristic of beetroot
  • Additives: No added carriers, preservatives or synthetic colours in the standard additive-free profile

Quality, Safety and Documentation

Quality control focuses on raw-material inspection, moisture control, sieving, batch identification, packaging integrity and traceability. Manufacturing and packing are managed using documented food-safety practices and standard operating procedures. Quality requirements can differ by destination market and end use; therefore, buyers should provide their required limits for microbiology, heavy metals, pesticides, allergens, residual solvents or other parameters before order confirmation. Tradenest Naturals does not assume a certification or regulatory approval unless it has been specifically confirmed for the relevant product, facility and shipment. Buyers may request available technical documents, product specifications, batch information, packing details and applicable export documentation during the quotation process. Destination-country compliance, labelling language, ingredient declaration and import requirements are reviewed with the customer before dispatch.

Applications

Dehydrated beetroot powder is a versatile ingredient for dry and wet food systems. It may be used to add beetroot character, visual appeal or plant-based ingredient value, subject to the requirements of the finished product. It can be dispersed into liquid systems, blended into dry premixes or incorporated during dough, batter, filling and seasoning preparation.
  • Smoothies, wellness beverages and instant drink mixes
  • Bakery products, doughs, cakes, biscuits and bread mixes
  • Snack seasonings, savoury blends and instant food products
  • Soups, sauces, dips, gravies and ready-to-cook mixes
  • Confectionery, dessert mixes and ice cream formulations
  • Plant-based foods, nutrition blends and health-food products
  • Private-label retail packs and ingredient kits
Use levels depend on the desired flavour, colour contribution, processing conditions and recipe balance. Pilot trials help determine dispersion, stability, sensory impact and compatibility with other ingredients.

Buyer Value

  • Convenient dry ingredient format reduces handling compared with fresh beetroot.
  • Extended shelf life supports inventory planning and international distribution.
  • Bulk supply can improve procurement efficiency and production cost control.
  • Standardized milling and sieving support more consistent blending and dosing.
  • Flexible packaging and private-label options support different sales channels.
  • Indian manufacturing and export support provide a practical sourcing route for global buyers.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Packaging is selected according to product quantity, market, transport conditions and customer requirements. Standard options include food-grade moisture-resistant inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and export-ready bulk bags or cartons. Custom printed packaging, private-label labels and shipment-specific export packing can be evaluated for suitable order volumes. Each packed unit is labelled with relevant details such as product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and applicable regulatory information. A typical unopened shelf-life target is 12 to 24 months from manufacture when packed appropriately and stored under recommended conditions. The final shelf life is confirmed according to the agreed formulation, packaging barrier, batch assessment and destination requirements. Store the powder tightly closed in a cool, dry and clean area away from direct sunlight, heat, moisture, strong odours and chemical contaminants. Reseal opened packs promptly and use clean, dry utensils during handling.

Wholesale MOQ, Lead Time and Samples

What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale beetroot powder? Standard bulk orders may start from approximately 25 kg, subject to stock, packaging format and destination. Smaller trial quantities may be possible for evaluation, while private-label, custom formulation and printed packaging orders generally require a higher MOQ. The final MOQ is confirmed after reviewing the requested quantity, pack size, label design, specifications and production plan. What is the lead time? Lead time depends on raw-material availability, current production schedule, order volume, testing, packaging and shipping documentation. Standard orders may typically require approximately 2 to 4 weeks after specification and artwork approval; customized or private-label orders may require additional time. These are planning estimates rather than guaranteed delivery commitments. How do I request a sample or quote? Send your required quantity, application, mesh size, packaging preference, destination country, target specification and whether private-label service is needed. Tradenest Naturals can then review feasibility, confirm MOQ, share available technical information, advise on sample options and prepare a commercial quotation. Early technical communication helps prevent delays and ensures that the supplied material matches the intended use.

Why Source from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals, part of Tradenest International, works as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter and private-label partner for dehydrated ingredients and food solutions. Our capabilities include dehydration, grinding, pulverizing, sieving, blending, custom formulation, product standardization, bulk packing and OEM support. We aim to provide clear specifications, dependable communication and practical solutions rather than a one-size-fits-all supply model. Whether you are searching for a beetroot powder supplier India, a beetroot powder exporter India, an beetroot powder wholesale partner or a dehydrated beetroot powder exporter for regular shipments, requirements are reviewed individually. Organic supply should be requested separately because organic status depends on verified raw-material sourcing, applicable certification and the specific production lot. Contact Tradenest Naturals to discuss your requirement and build a supply program suited to your market.
